pk.context: 60 mg subcutaneous, single dose, healthy adults

pill.desc: clear, colorless to pale yellow solution in a single-dose prefilled syringe

clues.kinetics: The drug shows no accumulation with repeated dosing, and renal impairment has no effect on its pharmacokinetics.
clues.substance: Produced in genetically engineered Chinese hamster ovary cells, with a molecular weight of about 147 kDa. Supplied as a preservative-free, sorbitol-containing solution.
clues.product: Approved under a BLA, dosed once every 6 months.
clues.safety: Boxed warning for severe hypocalcemia in advanced kidney disease. Contraindicated with pre-existing hypocalcemia, pregnancy or hypersensitivity; back pain and arthralgia are common.
clues.indication: Osteoporosis in postmenopausal women and men at high risk for fracture, glucocorticoid-induced osteoporosis, and bone mass in people on cancer hormone therapy.
clues.mechanism: Binds RANKL and prevents it from activating RANK on osteoclasts, inhibiting their formation, function and survival.

tell: Its RANKL target and boxed warning for severe hypocalcemia in advanced kidney disease set it apart.
